title: Designing Human-AI Collaboration to Support Learning in Counterspeech Writing

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated through a user study where participants used a human-AI collaborative system (CounterQuill) to analyze and co-write counterspeech responses to hate speech examples targeting race.
